title: PositivelyPetrified [BNB Standalone #3]
description: Petrified Oak but there's more of it.
body:
Another groundbreaking idea from Amber, eh? So, ever wanted an expansion on Petrified Oak Slabs? Yeah, me too.  

Anyways, this mod adds Petrified Oak Trees and logs and everything... besides signs, boats, leaves, saplings, doors, and trapdoors.

Have fun using a pickaxe on logs.
